title: AceSpawners
description: This Plugin adds configurable spawners to your minecraft server
body:
# 🧬 AceSpawners

AceSpawners is a powerful and highly optimized spawner plugin designed for modern Minecraft servers. Run `/spawners` to open a GUI where you can create, view, and manage all your custom spawners.

---

## 🔬 Why AceSpawners?

Vanilla Minecraft spawners are extremely limited and offer no control over rewards or performance. **AceSpawners** completely redefines mob generation by giving server owners absolute configuration power and modern performance tools.

This results in:
* **Absolute Customization:** Every single aspect—from custom loot percentages to precise cooldowns—is fully under your control.
* **Hybrid Flexibility:** Choose exactly how your spawners behave by utilizing either highly customized classic or virtual setups.
* **Performance:** Handle high-density spawning environments while keeping your server as smooth as possible.

---

## ✨ Core Mechanics & Technical Features

### 📦 Virtual Spawners & Stacking

* **Spawner Stacking:** Stack multiple spawners into a single one.
* **Built-in Storage:** Integrated internal storage that automatically collects mob loot without dropping items on the ground.
* **💰 Instant Sell Button:** Includes a "Sell All" button directly inside the storage interface to instantly sell your loot (Requires **Vault** and an economy plugin).
* **🧪 XP Storage:** Safely accumulates and stores mob experience points inside the spawner up to a configurable cap.

---

### 💀 Classic Spawners
Maintain the classic Minecraft feel while gaining absolute control over your mob generation behavior.

* **Custom Drops:** Set precise item rewards with exact percentage drop chances.
* **Spawn Settings:** Configure exact cooldowns, max nearby mobs, and the exact number of mobs that spawn per cycle.
* **AI Toggle:** Choose whether spawned mobs should have vanilla AI enabled or disabled.
* **Custom XP:** Edit and customize the precise amount of experience points each individual mob gives.

---

### ⚡ Optimization & Management
Powerful administrative tools designed to give server owners total control over their economy.

* **🏷️ Holograms:** Sleek, easily customizable floating text displaying live stats above the spawner.
* **🔄 Global Sync:** Modify a spawner's settings in the configuration and update all active spawners of that type across the server.
* **📊 Global List:** Access a complete, centralized directory showing the exact locations of every single placed spawner.
* **🗑️ Mass Delete:** Wipe all spawners of a specific type server-wide with a single click.

---
